temperature.name: Daily mean temperature
temperature.description: Avoid winter scenes where NDVI is undefined.

precipitation_today.name: Today's precipitation
precipitation_today.description: Dry surface — less likely to have cloud cover at overpass.

precipitation_prev48h.name: Precipitation, previous 48 hours
precipitation_prev48h.description: Atmosphere needs time to clear after rain events.

precipitation_prev7d.name: Precipitation, previous 7 days
precipitation_prev7d.description: Wet week — residual humidity and convective afternoon cloud for several days afterwards.

cloud_total.name: Total cloud cover at overpass
cloud_total.description: Direct cloud signal at ~10:30 UTC overpass; comes in the same Open-Meteo response as the land variables.

cloud_low.name: Low cloud cover at overpass
cloud_low.description: Low clouds (stratus, fog) are the main Sentinel-2 killer.

solar_radiation.name: Daily solar radiation
solar_radiation.description: High daily insolation correlates with clear-sky days.

precipitation_prev30d.name: Cumulative precipitation, previous 30 days
precipitation_prev30d.description: Stay in climatologically 'normal' band; below = drought NDVI suppression, above = waterlogging.

gdd_accumulation.name: Growing degree days, previous 30 days (base 5 C)
gdd_accumulation.description: Ensures vegetation is in an active growth window.

soil_moisture_history.name: Rootzone moisture, previous 30 days
soil_moisture_history.description: Avoid scenes where 30-day soil dryness or saturation dominates the spectral signal.
